name: Android application and acquisition service
purpose: Own permissions, the user-started location foreground service, SensorManager/LocationManager callbacks, capabilities and live/replay source selection.
responsibilities: Preserve native samples; tag provider and clocks; expose lifecycle/context; never estimate or rewrite evidence.
inputs: Android callbacks; replay source; user commands
failure_behaviour: Fail closed on missing mandatory accelerometer/gyro or permission; publish capability status
required_tests: JVM; instrumentation; physical-device S1
current_evidence_status: S1 implementation verified; physical protocol incomplete

name: Session evidence writer
purpose: Persist immutable, replayable source evidence and manifests.
responsibilities: Append JSONL chunks; sequence, hash, fsync, rotate, recover partial sessions, export ZIP.
failure_behaviour: Mark INCOMPLETE or EVIDENCE_DEGRADED; never invent missing records
required_tests: Writer unit; crash recovery; low-storage; replay round-trip
current_evidence_status: S1 writer path verified synthetically; device durability pending

name: Timebase and sensor-quality adapter
purpose: Validate ordering/rates without destroying source timing or axes.
responsibilities: Compute dt/age; retain arrival time; detect gaps, batching, non-monotonicity, saturation and missing streams; form bounded batches.
owned_state: Per-stream last sequence/timestamp and health windows
failure_behaviour: Reject invalid core input while recording the raw event and typed reason
required_tests: Property; fixtures; S1 replay
current_evidence_status: S1 contract verified; delivered rates device-specific

name: Calibration manager
purpose: Supply bias/noise priors and stationary evidence; never own the operational bias.
responsibilities: Stationary detection, profile selection, prior covariance and validity.
failure_behaviour: Emit invalid/unavailable prior; core uses conservative initialization
required_tests: Synthetic stationary; replay; prior/core ownership invariant
current_evidence_status: Method not physically validated; S2 boundary frozen

name: Alignment and mount-state estimator
purpose: Own phone-body to vehicle rotation posterior and mount-change state outside S2.
responsibilities: Estimate alignment with covariance; gate observability; detect change; expose VALID/UNCERTAIN/SLIP_SUSPECTED.
failure_behaviour: Disable alignment-dependent learned/kinematic constraints; never fabricate yaw
required_tests: S3 controlled orientation/slip protocol; replay; absent magnetometer
current_evidence_status: S3 unresolved mandatory gate

name: Navigation-core JNI adapter
purpose: Batch canonical measurements into the C++ core without Android types or per-sample serialization.
responsibilities: Validate ABI/schema; copy/direct-buffer ownership; serialize calls on one executor; translate typed results.
owned_state: Core handle and ABI version only
failure_behaviour: Stop scientific output and publish CORE_FAULT; never restart as continuous state
required_tests: JNI contract; lifecycle; malformed buffer; parity fixtures
current_evidence_status: Boundary selected; integration not executed

name: Canonical C++ navigation core
purpose: Sole owner of S2 nominal state, operational biases, covariance, evidence-ID ledger, propagation and GNSS updates.
responsibilities: S2 midpoint propagation; ESKF covariance; innovation gates; Joseph update; reset Jacobian; numerical checks.
failure_behaviour: Reject invalid dt/evidence; surface numeric fault; no state repair that hides defects
required_tests: S2 unit; finite difference; C++/NumPy parity; fuzz/property
current_evidence_status: S2 bounded mathematical behaviour accepted; real-phone drift unproved

name: Learned-correction adapter
purpose: Run an optional bounded model and decide whether its proposal is eligible.
responsibilities: Window/mask/normalize; deadline; OOD/range checks; shadow mode; provenance; never mutate raw evidence.
owned_state: Window buffer, runtime/model identity and counters
failure_behaviour: Reject/timeout and continue classical baseline
required_tests: Golden tensors; timeout/OOD; disabled-model baseline; export parity
current_evidence_status: S4 unexecuted; IO-VNBD private experiment permitted conditionally

name: GNSS integrity and reacquisition controller
purpose: Convert one provenance-preserving location family into canonical gated updates and controlled return.
responsibilities: Quality state; covariance floors; outage hysteresis; consume evidence once; dwell/consistency on return.
failure_behaviour: Reject inconsistent/stale fixes; remain DR/degraded; never privilege first return
required_tests: Biased/intermittent return; duplicate ID; stale fix; state-machine fixtures
current_evidence_status: S2 single-update gate accepted; thresholds provisional

name: Road-graph store and top-K matcher
purpose: Generate bounded directed-road hypotheses without overwriting navigation state.
responsibilities: Verify graph manifest; spatial candidates; topology/direction/covariance scores; top-K; ambiguity and abstention.
owned_state: Verified map version and previous same-version hypotheses
failure_behaviour: MISSING_MAP/NO_CANDIDATE/AMBIGUOUS; publish unmatched navigation
required_tests: S6 fixtures; determinism; version mismatch; false-clear negatives
current_evidence_status: S6B1 deterministic graph and two route candidates accepted conditionally; runtime matcher unbuilt

name: Navigation-state repository and output publisher
purpose: Publish immutable scientific snapshots and separately derived display snapshots.
responsibilities: Approximately 10 Hz output pacing; monotonic revision; no feedback from display smoothing; expose modes/provenance.
failure_behaviour: Hold last display only with STALE marker; scientific output invalid/stopped is explicit
required_tests: Rate; separation; stale/fault; process recreation
current_evidence_status: Contract selected; integrated rate pending

name: Replay provider and demo scenario controller
purpose: Provide deterministic recorded input and software-only GNSS visibility control through live-compatible contracts.
responsibilities: Replay ordering; speed/pause/seek restrictions; scenario masks; labels LIVE/REPLAY/SIMULATED_OUTAGE/DEMO.
failure_behaviour: Reject corrupt/incomplete sessions unless explicitly diagnostic; no silent repair
required_tests: Determinism; corrupted manifest; mask isolation; live/replay contract
current_evidence_status: Architecture decision accepted; implementation pending

name: Offline map and navigation UI
purpose: Render local map, routes, scientific/reference traces, candidates, uncertainty and honest mode labels.
responsibilities: MapLibre local PMTiles; attribution; UI state adaptation; after-run comparison; accessibility.
failure_behaviour: Show map unavailable and retain textual scientific state; never fake movement
required_tests: Screenshot/accessibility; airplane mode; attribution; device renderer
current_evidence_status: S6A foundation conditional; Android renderer not validated

name: Offline analyzer and evaluation harness
purpose: Reproduce sessions and compute drift, latency, rate, integrity, map and resource metrics.
responsibilities: Immutable input verification; endpoint/max/RMSE metrics; unmatched/matched/display separation; reports.
outputs: Versioned evaluation reports and experiment manifests
failure_behaviour: No metric on failed provenance/ground-truth checks
required_tests: Golden metrics; independent recomputation; malformed inputs
current_evidence_status: S1 analyzer pattern verified; full integrated analyzer pending

name: IO-VNBD ingestion and feature firewall
purpose: Privately ingest allowed IO-VNBD bytes, validate schemas/dedup/splits and prevent vehicle-label leakage.
responsibilities: Pinned manifests; six-schema allowlist; parent-session split; runtime-feature audit; no raw public artifacts.
failure_behaviour: Quarantine unknown schema/hash/unit; stop experiment
required_tests: Schema/dedup/leakage/canary/future-GNSS tests
current_evidence_status: S0 audit complete; status overridden to organizer-directed conditional private use

name: Training and evaluation pipeline
purpose: Train/ablate optional learned aids with journey-safe splits and frozen scenarios.
responsibilities: Baselines; grouped splits; model/normalization provenance; evaluation; export candidate.
failure_behaviour: No export when leakage, rights, split or metric checks fail
required_tests: Determinism; split isolation; baselines; ablations
current_evidence_status: Experiment permitted conditionally; no performance executed

name: Model packaging validator
purpose: Prove exported model/runtime/normalization compatibility before Android inclusion.
responsibilities: Hash model; schema/opset/runtime version; golden-vector parity; size/latency budget; redistribution flag.
failure_behaviour: Reject bundle; app runs model-disabled
required_tests: Golden tensors; corrupt manifest; unsupported op; timeout
current_evidence_status: Unexecuted S4

name: Map and graph build tooling
purpose: Rebuild display/graph artifacts from one frozen lawful PBF with lineage.
responsibilities: Hash source; build PMTiles/SQLite; stable IDs; notices; fixtures and candidate routes.
failure_behaviour: Abort on hash/tool/lineage mismatch
required_tests: S6 deterministic build; graph schema/topology
current_evidence_status: S6B1 graph built: 19/19 tests; PMTiles/device path pending

name: Artifact and manifest validator
purpose: Validate all distributable artifacts, notices, hashes, schemas and forbidden content.
responsibilities: JSON/CSV/schema parsing; manifest hashes; clean extraction; secrets/private/raw-data checks.
failure_behaviour: Block merge/release
required_tests: Self-test fixtures; tamper detection
current_evidence_status: Pattern proven by S6 manifests; repo implementation pending

name: Contracts and configuration package
purpose: Version schemas, enums, units, frames, clock domains, validation and feature flags.
responsibilities: JSON Schema/Proto definitions; generated bindings; compatibility tests; configuration identity.
failure_behaviour: Unknown major version rejected; incompatible change requires ADR
required_tests: Schema compatibility; codegen determinism; round-trip
current_evidence_status: Conceptual contracts frozen by this baseline; implementation pending
